name: Jack ~Haitoku no Megami~
source:
You are Jack Martin, a drunken, selfish, sex-driven bastard of a detective. You recently received a job to capture the inter-galactic terrorist "Phantom". The Phantom has been confirmed to be heading toward a galactic convention on a transteller shuttle. This is where you come in. 

[From[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=468&style=alphabetical] Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
你是杰克·马丁，一名嗜酒、自私、被性欲驱使的混账侦探。你最近接到一份工作，要抓捕星际恐怖分子“幻影”。已确认“幻影”正前往一场星际大会，并搭乘跨星际穿梭机。这正是你登场的时候。

[摘自[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=468&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
